title: Bounded release calculus for published engineering relations: reproducibility package
description: Local R10 candidate metadata for a bounded-release calculus. The package binds a candidate engineering relation to typed predicates, finite-precision evidence and provenance, and returns exactly one auditable action: reject, retain a bounded claim, or allow a bounded query. Operational use remains outside the computational closure. This metadata is staged locally and is not an upload or a minted-release receipt.
